Dear Zofia,

Please take immediate safety measures:
1. Do not use any open flames (no smoking, matches, or lighters).
2. Do not touch any electrical switches, appliances, or plugs.
3. Open all windows and doors immediately to ventilate the area.
4. Leave the apartment right away.

Call our 24-hour hotline immediately at +49 30 5550 9999 from outside the building, and call 112 if anyone is in danger or if you smell gas in the hallway.

Your Lindwurm Hausverwaltung team

Dear Lina,

Thank you for reaching out immediately. No, this is not safe—sparks and a burning plastic smell indicate an electrical hazard. 

Please take the following steps right away:
- Keep everything unplugged from that socket.
- Do not touch the socket or any surrounding electrical switches.
- If possible and safe, switch off the power to that room at your fuse box/circuit breaker.
- If you notice any smoke or fire, leave the apartment immediately and call 112.

Please call our 24-hour hotline immediately at +49 30 5550 9999 so we can dispatch an emergency electrician to your apartment right away.

Your Lindwurm Hausverwaltung team
